title: The Equality of All Things
lines: Ziqi of South Wall sat leaning on his armrest,
Looking up at the sky and breathing gently,
As if he had lost all sense of his own existence.
Yan Cheng Ziyou stood in attendance and asked:
"What is this? Can the body truly become like dried wood,
And the mind like dead ashes?"
"Ziqi said: 'You ask well, Yan. Just now I lost myself —
That is what I mean. You have heard the pipes of men,
But not the pipes of earth.
You have heard the pipes of earth,
But not the pipes of heaven.'"
"The Great Earth breathes forth, and it is called wind."
"When it is still, there is nothing.
When it blows, the ten thousand hollows cry out wildly."
